injuries.t: LeBron James OUT (low back/sciatica), downgraded from questionable. Embiid likely sits one game of back-to-back. Barlow, Fall, Hukporti out; Wade Q.
Saka, Saliba, Tzolis out
Grealish (ill), Branthwaite (concussion protocol) out
Pep Chavarria out; Malo Gusto returns
QB M. Heintschel listed out-for-season
vs Michigan State: MSU QBs Alessio Milivojevic and Cam Fancher out, true freshman Kayd Coffman to start; UCLA also starting backup QB Ty Dieffenbach. UCLA leg kept but recheck line before kickoff.
Koundé (ankle) and Dani Olmo (adductor) out for El Clásico; Eric García and Christensen also out.
Storm Austen (80mph winds) puts Man United vs Bournemouth and Liverpool vs Brighton at risk of postponement; recheck before betting.
Lamar Jackson questionable (high ankle) for Sunday vs Bengals.
Curry out (rest, back-to-back), Podziemski out (back); Draymond Green doubtful.
Malkin out (illness); Girard to IR; Chinakhov out. Silovs starts.
Levi on IR; Jarry starts vs Toronto; Ekholm out 3 games.
Yves Missi out (knee).
Jalen Duren OUT (hamstring) Sunday at 76ers; Ausar Thompson questionable (ankle).
Paolo Banchero out 4-6 weeks (high ankle sprain).
Knueppel, Coby White, Boswell, Grant Williams out vs Heat (2nd of back-to-back).
DeVonta Smith, Nolan Smith, Wicks out Monday vs Cowboys; Barkley questionable.
S Jevon Holland (concussion) and TE Theo Johnson (neck) downgraded to OUT at Texans; Greg Newsome II out; Tremaine Edmunds to IR.
Bulls C Nic Claxton out (hamstring); Wizards rookie AJ Dybantsa out (ankle), third straight game.
Cameron Johnson, Spencer Jones, Strawther out; Alpha Diallo questionable vs Pelicans.

vs Suns: Curry (knee management), Draymond Green (back), Podziemski (back), Horford (back) out; Butler, Moody, Porzingis also out. Suns: Ighodaro out. Supports Suns -6.5 leg; line likely already adjusted.
Mikel Brown Jr. - Out: Head coach Jordi Fernandez said Brown (rest) will be held out of Sunday's game against the Pacers, Brian Lewis of the New York Post reports.
Tyler Bilodeau - Out: Bilodeau (shoulder) has been ruled out for Saturday's game in Cleveland.
Ausar Thompson - Day-To-Day: Thompson (ankle) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against Philadelphia.
Jalen Duren - Out: Duren has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the 76ers due to a right hamstring strain, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.
Aaron Nesmith - Day-To-Day: Nesmith (hamstring) is listed as probable for Sunday's game against Brooklyn.
T.J. McConnell - Out: McConnell (hamstring) is out for Sunday's game against the Nets.
Ben Sheppard - Out: Sheppard has been diagnosed with a torn meniscus in his left knee and is without a timetable for a return to game action, Scott Agness of FieldhouseFiles.com reports.
Johnny Furphy - Out: Furphy was diagnosed with a torn right ACL on Monday and will miss the remainder of the season, Michael Scotto of USA Today reports.
Bradley Beal - Out: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.
Max Strus - Out: Strus has been diagnosed with a partially torn plantar fascia in his right foot and he will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.
Yanic Konan Niederhauser - Out: Niederhauser (foot) won't be ready for the start of the season, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.
Brandon Ingram - Out: Ingram won't be ready for the start of the season due to a partially torn Achilles, per Joey Linn of SI.com.
Jordan Miller - Out: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.
Adou Thiero - Out: Thiero (knee) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against Utah, Khobi Price of The California Post reports.
Cameron Carr - Out: Carr (oblique) is out for Sunday's game in Utah, Khobi Price of The California Post reports.
Cedric Coward - Day-To-Day: Coward (wrist) is questionable for Sunday's game in Sacramento.
Zach Edey - Out: Edey has been ruled out for Sunday's game against Sacramento due to left ankle injury management.
Donte DiVincenzo - Out: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.
Jose Alvarado - Day-To-Day: Alvarado is questionable for Sunday's game against Orlando due to a left ankle sprain.
Otega Oweh - Out: The Thunder plan to waive Oweh (Achilles) on Friday.
Nikola Topic - Out: Topic (back) won't play in Thursday's game against the Nuggets.
Thomas Sorber - Out: Sorber (knee) is listed as out for Thursday's game against Denver.
Jonathan Isaac - Out: Isaac (knee) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Knicks.
Anthony Black - Day-To-Day: Black (ankle) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Knicks.
Paolo Banchero - Out: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Noah Penda - Out: Penda was diagnosed with a partially torn right hamstring Saturday, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

Izaiyah Nelson - Out: Team president Jeff Weltman said Monday that Nelson (ankle) remains about a month away from returning to the court after offseason surgery, per Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com.
Joel Embiid - Day-To-Day: Embiid produced 28 points (8-20 FG, 0-3 3Pt, 12-14 FT), 11 rebounds, 10 assists, one steal and four turnovers across 36 minutes in Saturday's 127-116 win over the Bucks.

Jabari Walker - Day-To-Day: Walker (ankle) exited Saturday's 127-116 win over the Bucks in the third quarter and did not return, finishing with six points (2-3 FG, 2-3 FT), three rebounds, one assist and one steal across 12 minutes.
LeBron James - Out: James (back) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Bucks, Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com reports.
Tacko Fall - Out: Fall (quadriceps) is out for Saturday's game against the Bucks.
Dominick Barlow - Out: Barlow will miss at least the next two weeks of action due to a lumbar spine bone stress response, Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com reports.
Ariel Hukporti - Out: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
Keegan Murray - Day-To-Day: Murray is questionable to play Sunday against the Grizzlies due to left ankle capsulitis.
Ben Simmons - Out: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.

Dylan Cardwell - Out: Cardwell (calf) is expected to miss at least the first five or six games of the regular season, with a longer absence possible, Frankie Cartoscelli of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.
